review_scope: Exploratory assistant inspection of 16 fresh development conversation groups; no independent human scores or overall accuracy established. These cases are now inspected development material.

findings.finding: Gated paired training demonstrates limited supplied-act controllability on some fresh examples.

No reliable automatic pipeline improvement established: predicted accept still leads to accepting 7:50 despite volunteering until8:20, agreeing to heavy lifting with injured shoulder, and accepting overbudget breakfast.
Even supplied decline/counterproposal acts fail on duration conflict, overbudget meal and online-only availability.
The explicit text-goal arm largely ignores requested alternatives and sometimes regresses factual state; no demonstrated advantage over gated or direct arms.
LOCAL can reverse correct STANDARD refusals and remove uncertainty. Assess generator and rewriter separately.

conclusion: Small proof of some decoder act sensitivity, not a reliable contextual or end-to-end upgrade. No new runs or default replacements.
